statusLine.command: jq -r 'def fmtdur(s): if s >= 86400 then (s/86400|floor) as $d | ((s%86400)/3600|floor) as $h | "\($d)d \($h)h" else (s/3600|floor) as $h | ((s%3600)/60|floor) as $m | "\($h)h \($m)m" end; [ "model: \(.model.display_name)", (if .effort.level then "effort: \(.effort.level)" else empty end), (if .context_window.used_percentage then "ctx: \(.context_window.used_percentage|floor)% used" else empty end), (if .rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage then "5h: \(.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage|floor)% (resets in \(fmtdur(.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at - now)))" else empty end), (if .rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage then "7d: \(.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage|floor)% (resets in \(fmtdur(.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at - now)))" else empty end) ] | join(" | ")'
